title: Multi-Purpose Tokens
key_points: Multi-purpose tokens are a type of fungible token that can represent various assets or rights.
They are created by issuing a new class of tokens on the ledger.
The issuer has control over the lifecycle and properties of multi-purpose tokens.
limitations: This document does not discuss the recency or usage statistics of these tokens.
asserts: Multi-purpose tokens are flexible, user-defined assets issued on the XRP Ledger.
